steps.description:
Care Request Type names the kind of help needed: Meal, Transport, Hospital Visit, etc.

Pick a Category to continue.
steps.label: Category
steps.title: Category

steps.description: Members can submit Care Requests themselves through the portal's Care Request form, so expect their own words here rather than a tidy summary.
steps.label: What Is Needed
steps.title: What Is Needed

steps.description: Filled in on save from the person's current Care Assignment. Change it to hand the request to someone else. When the caregiver has a desk login, the request goes on their To Do list and they get a notice.
steps.label: Caregiver
steps.title: Caregiver

steps.description: Low through Urgent. The urgency sets the Due On date: Urgent 1 day, High 3 days, Medium 7 days, Low 14 days. Change the urgency later and the due date moves with it.
steps.label: Urgency
steps.title: Urgency

steps.description: Requested, Triaged, In Progress, then Resolved or Closed. Write the Resolution Notes before resolving: they are what whoever takes the next request reads first.
steps.label: Status
steps.title: Status
